title: Anti-isomorphisms and the naturality of channel--state duality
summary: Channel--state duality identifies completely positive maps with bipartite states. Its generalisation to von Neumann algebras is known to produce states not on $\mathcal{M}\bar{\otimes}\mathcal{N}$ but on the tensor product of $\mathcal{M}$ with the \emph{opposite} algebra of $\mathcal{N}$, or equivalently with a commutant; returning to $\mathcal{N}$ itself requires a transposition, and it has been observed that this step typically fails.
